scenes: Original children's picture book, playful expressive ink outlines and soft watercolor with snowy white paper, winter indigo blue, coral red and warm amber palette. No text or numbers, no named artist imitation. Consistent characters: friendly black-and-white penguin conductor with navy peaked cap and red scarf; girl with black bob in mustard winter coat and cream hat; boy brown curly hair in teal winter coat. A miniature storybook snow railway, tiny coral red locomotive, wooden station with amber windows and triangular roof, smiling snowman with green scarf. Treasure is a small penguin-shaped locomotive: black rounded body, white front face and belly, orange beak, two black wing side panels, navy cab roof, four orange wheels. Exact 2 by 2 grid of square panels with thin straight white gutters. Top left BEFORE: overhead-ish view of tiny red train circling on a closed oval track around smiling snowman; conductor and children puzzled outside circle, station visible beyond track. Top right AFTER: branch track leads red locomotive to warm wooden station, conductor and children cheering beside platform. Bottom left spare: penguin-shaped toy locomotive treasure on bench. Bottom right HOST portrait of friendly penguin conductor navy cap and red scarf with snowy station background. All subjects inside each cell.
